method_card.title: Accommodation and Hotel Stays
method_card.content:
This lesson covers hotel and campsite vocabulary, booking a room, requesting facilities and making complaints using polite conditional forms.

FrenchEnglish
une chambre doublea double room
une chambre individuellea single room
une chambre familialea family room
avec douche / avec bainwith shower / with bath
avec vue sur la merwith a sea view
pour trois nuitsfor three nights
le petit-déjeuner comprisbreakfast included
en demi-pensionhalf board
un campinga campsite
une auberge de jeunessea youth hostel
un gîtea holiday cottage
ne marche pasdoesn't work
c'est casséit's broken
la chambre est salethe room is dirty
(Higher) la climatisation(Higher) air conditioning

The conditional for polite requests: je voudrais (I would like), j'aimerais (I would love). Using the conditional tense shows higher grammatical range. Compare: je veux (I want — present) vs je voudrais (I would like — conditional, more polite).

Complaints: Use fixed phrases: ...ne marche pas or ...ne fonctionne pas (doesn't work), c'est cassé (it's broken), il n'y a pas de... (there isn't any...). After pas de, the article disappears: il n'y a pas de serviettes (there are no towels).

Model paragraph: Je voudrais réserver une chambre double avec douche pour quatre nuits, s'il vous plaît. Est-ce que le petit-déjeuner est compris? Malheureusement, la climatisation ne marche pas et il n'y a pas de serviettes dans la chambre. (I would like to book a double room with shower for four nights, please. Is breakfast included? Unfortunately, the air conditioning doesn't work and there are no towels in the room.)
steps: Learn room types, facilities and accommodation vocabulary
Master polite request phrases using the conditional (je voudrais, j'aimerais)
Practice key complaint phrases for hotel and campsite problems
Combine booking and complaint language for role-play scenarios

exam_context.frequency: Hotel and campsite role-plays are a core transactional context in the speaking exam

worked_examples.question: Translate to English: 'Je voudrais réserver une chambre double avec douche pour cinq nuits.'

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Break it down: Je voudrais | réserver | une chambre double | avec douche | pour cinq nuits.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: Je voudrais = I would like (conditional). réserver = to book. une chambre double = a double room.

steps.label: Step 3
steps.content: avec douche = with shower. pour cinq nuits = for five nights.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: I would like to book a double room with shower for five nights.

worked_examples.question: How do you make a complaint about your hotel room in French?

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: State the problem using set phrases: ...ne marche pas (doesn't work), c'est cassé (it's broken), il n'y a pas de... (there isn't any...), la chambre est sale (the room is dirty).

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: Remember: after pas de or pas d', the article disappears — you say il n'y a pas de serviettes, not des serviettes.

steps.label: Step 3
steps.content: Request a solution using the conditional: Je voudrais une autre chambre (I would like another room) or Je voudrais un remboursement (I would like a refund).

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: State the problem (ne marche pas, c'est cassé, il n'y a pas de...), then request a solution with je voudrais.

bronze.question: Match the French hotel vocabulary to the English meaning
Match the French accommodation types to the English meaning
Complete the hotel booking with the correct words

gaps.correct_explain: voudrais (I would like) is the conditional form of vouloir, used for polite requests.

wrong.veux: veux means 'I want' — it works but voudrais is more polite and shows the conditional tense.
wrong.vouloir: vouloir is the infinitive. You need the conjugated conditional form: voudrais.

gaps.correct_explain: double means a double room. Individuelle (single) or familiale (family) also work here.

wrong.grand: grand means big/tall — it is not a room type. Use double, individuelle or familiale.

gaps.correct_explain: douche (shower) is a common room facility. Bain (bath) or balcon (balcony) also work.

wrong.piscine: piscine (swimming pool) is a hotel facility, not usually in a avec room description. Try douche or bain.

gaps.correct_explain: ne marche pas = doesn't work. Ne fonctionne pas also works.

wrong.travaille: travailler means 'to work' (as in a job), not 'to function'. Use marche or fonctionne.

gaps.correct_explain: sale = dirty. La chambre est sale = The room is dirty.

wrong.propre: propre means clean — the opposite of what you want in a complaint. You need sale (dirty).

gaps.correct_explain: serviettes (towels) is a common complaint. wifi or climatisation also work.

wrong.chambre: chambre (room) doesn't fit after il n'y a pas de in a complaint context. Try serviettes or wifi.

bronze.question: What does 'L'ascenseur est en panne depuis hier' mean?
options: The lift has been out of order since yesterday
The lift is on the first floor
The lift is working since yesterday

bronze.question: Which phrase means 'I would like a room with a sea view'?
options: Je voudrais une chambre avec vue sur la mer
J'ai une chambre avec vue sur la mer
Je vais avoir une chambre avec vue sur la mer
Je prends une chambre avec vue sur la mer

bronze.source_text: Je voudrais une chambre familiale en demi-pension pour une semaine. Est-ce qu'il y a une piscine?
model_answers: I would like a family room with half board for a week. Is there a swimming pool?
hints: pour une semaine = for a week
est-ce qu'il y a = is there

silver.question: Complete the sentence by typing the correct word
silver.english: I would like to book a single room with bath for a fortnight.

wrong.commander: commander means to order (food/goods), not to book a room. Use réserver.
wrong.réservé: réservé is the past participle. After voudrais, you need the infinitive: réserver.

wrong.double: double means a double room, not a single room. You need individuelle.
wrong.simple: simple is not the standard French term. The correct word is individuelle.

wrong.deux: deux would mean 'two days', not a fortnight. The French expression is quinze jours.
wrong.quatorze: quatorze jours (14 days) is logical but the French idiom for a fortnight is quinze jours (15 days).

silver.question: Find and fix the grammatical error
silver.sentence: La télévision ne marche pas et la climatisation est cassé.
silver.explanation: La climatisation is feminine, so the adjective must agree: cassée (add -e for feminine).
silver.translation: The television doesn't work and the air conditioning is broken.

silver.question: Build the sentence in French
silver.english: I would like another room because the shower doesn't work.

distractor_labels.veux: not wrong grammatically but voudrais is the conditional (more polite and better exam style)

gold.question: Build the sentence in French

distractor_labels.veux: veux is less polite — voudrais (conditional) is better exam style for a complaint

gold.question: Role Play
gold.scenario: You are at a hotel in France. You arrive at reception to check in and later need to make a complaint about your room.

bullets.prompt: Greet the receptionist and say you have a reservation for a double room.
bullets.model_answer: Bonjour, j'ai une réservation pour une chambre double, s'il vous plaît.
bullets.note: greeting + j'ai une réservation + room type + polite s'il vous plaît

bullets.prompt: Ask if breakfast is included and if there is free wifi.
bullets.model_answer: Est-ce que le petit-déjeuner est compris? Et est-ce qu'il y a du wifi gratuit?
bullets.note: est-ce que (question form) + le petit-déjeuner compris + wifi gratuit

bullets.prompt: Complain about two problems in your room.
bullets.model_answer: Excusez-moi, la douche ne marche pas et il n'y a pas de serviettes dans la chambre.
bullets.note: ne marche pas + il n'y a pas de — two distinct complaints

bullets.prompt: Ask for a solution to the problem.
bullets.model_answer: Je voudrais une autre chambre, s'il vous plaît, ou un remboursement.
bullets.note: je voudrais (conditional) + une autre chambre / un remboursement

gold.question: Complete the sentence by typing the correct word (Higher tier — conditional and imperfect)
gold.english: If the hotel were cheaper, we would stay for a fortnight.

gaps.correct_explain: était is the imperfect of être. In si + imperfect + conditional structures, the si clause uses the imperfect.

wrong.est: est is the present tense. After si in a hypothetical, you need the imperfect: était.
wrong.serait: serait is the conditional. The conditional goes in the result clause, not the si clause. Use était.

gaps.correct_explain: resterions is the nous form of the conditional of rester. The result clause uses the conditional.

wrong.restons: restons is the present tense. After si + imperfect, the result clause needs the conditional: resterions.
wrong.restions: restions is the imperfect nous form. The result clause requires the conditional: resterions.
